prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A four-asset illustration sheet for Android FitnessApp, exercise Aperturas en máquina (chest_machine_fly). EXACT FOUR EQUAL PANELS, STRICT 2x2 grid with perfectly centered vertical and horizontal division. No borders, no margins, NO TEXT NO LABELS NO NUMBERS NO LOGOS. Upper-left movement initial position; upper-right middle of movement; lower-left final contraction/end range; lower-right muscle map. The first three panels show same realistic adult athlete, same modest charcoal sleeveless gym top and shorts, same camera angle and same equipment; three clearly DIFFERENT poses to explain the motion. Choose three-quarter SIDE view that makes the movement and joint angles unmistakable. All relevant limbs and equipment fully inside each panel, normal five-finger hands, plausible equipment and joints. Dark studio background #121416, warm soft champagne rim light, consistent photorealistic 3D educational illustration, realistic light loads. Setup: Ajusta el asiento para que las asas queden a la altura del pecho. Espalda apoyada y codos ligeramente flexionados. Sequence technique: Junta las asas delante del pecho describiendo un arco amplio. Aprieta el pecho un instante con las manos juntas. Abre despacio hasta notar estiramiento sin que los brazos vayan por detrás del cuerpo. Show EXACT named variant and equipment, not a substitute movement. Do not merge multiple athletes in a movement panel. No arrows inside frames. Bottom-right panel contains TWO neutral gray anatomical adult full-body figures FRONT and BACK side by side, modest neutral briefs, with accurately bounded colored muscles, no glow, no heatmap. Primary pectoralis major pale champagne; secondary anterior deltoid and triceps muted amber. For machine fly omit triceps as significant secondary. Primary color #D8C3A5; secondary #A77B47; unworked skin/muscles gray. Other figures and diagrams must not intrude in movement panels. Four assets will be cropped into independent rectangular images. Keep composition centered with 5% breathing room within EACH quadrant. Avoid decorative text, incorrect cable attachment, floating handles, disconnected weights. Instructional visual draft, not diagnosis.
